text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna invites me out for a slightly late
New
Year's shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wow... The New Year's festivities are
already
over, but there are still so many
people here!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, speaking of the midwinter crowds,
this
reminds me of last year's Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't there?! It's the big year-end
event, after
all! The perfect end to all
the G1 races that start
in autumn!
choice_data_list: 確かに、大賑わいでしたね

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And on the topic of the Arima Kinen, it's
a really
important race for so many
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Only the chosen few can stand upon that

stage—the ones who performed the best
that year
and won the hearts of the
fans...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Racers from every generation dream of
standing
tall at Nakayama Racecourse at
the end of the
year.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: That's right... They all yearn for it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And somehow, I feel that yearning too! I
know it's
a little far away, but why don't
we head to
Nakayama Racecourse for a
quick peek?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Visiting a shrine for the New Year
is great
and all, but the bustle of the
racetrack is on a
whole other level!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There are people at the racetrack to
watch
Umamusume run today as well.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Please continue to support your
trainee.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'll be rooting for the both of you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that my friendship with
Tazuna
will continue to grow from here.
